instruction: Apply bold formatting to all textual elements throughout the presentation by adjusting the Slide Master settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making all text bold via Slide Master view. The custom getter counts total text runs and bold text runs across all slides, and the metric checks that all runs are bold (bold_runs == total_runs). This is verified by iterating through all slides, shapes, paragraphs, and runs to check the bold property.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts bold status by iterating through all slides, shapes, paragraphs, and text runs
Getter properly counts total_runs and bold_runs, filtering out empty text runs
Metric logic correctly checks if all text runs are bold (bold_runs == total_runs)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks all text content across the entire presentation
Postconfig includes proper steps to activate window, save file, and allow processing time
Minor issue: Metric function does not use the 'expected' parameter (which contains {'all_bold': true}), though the hard-coded logic happens to match the expected behavior
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using the 'expected' parameter in the metric function for better framework alignment, e.g., 'if expected.get('all_bold', False) and bold == total and total > 0: return 1.0'
This would make the metric more flexible and properly aligned with the framework's rule-based design pattern
